purpose: The frozen evaluation substrate for Pāṭala. Tests MACHINES that propose scholarship. Pāṭala PRODUCT publishes scholarship; PĀṬALA BENCHMARK tests machines — do not let them collapse. Published objects may create candidate fixtures, but the benchmark has an explicit adjudication boundary.
honesty_rules: Schema-valid ≠ source-grounded ≠ interpretively justified ≠ logically valid ≠ historically true.
A fixture produced by method X cannot be independent gold for evaluating method X.
Every run is immutable and reproducible (runs/<timestamp>/ with version, split, config, predictions, metrics, commit).
No magical aggregate score: report per-metric, not one 'argument_quality' number.
Fixtures marked allowed_training_use=false are EVALUATION_ONLY (no model selection against them).
pre_benchmark_rule: Any ad-hoc experimental result not rerun against this frozen suite is marked PRE-BENCHMARK and retired from claims.
